create_repitched_wrapper: create a RepitchedWrapper around a dataset to apply random pitch and tempo augmentation
repitch_audio_wav: repitch a wav tensor by a given number of semitones and tempo percentage using soundstretch
repitch_voice_audio: repitch a vocal audio stream with speech mode enabled for voice-specific pitch and tempo changes
review_repitched_wrapper_getitem: review the RepitchedWrapper getitem method to understand how random pitch and tempo deltas are applied per stream
summarize_repitch_function: summarize the repitch function which uses soundstretch CLI to change pitch in semitones and tempo in percentage
